${\int }_{C}6 y\,\text{d}s,$
where $C$ is the section of the curve $x=2 y + 2$ from $(4,1)$ to $(6,2).$" :question/worked-solution "Notice that the given curve is of the form $x=x(y),$ Therefore, by setting $y=t,$ we have

$$
x=x(t)=2 t + 2.
$$

This gives the following parametrization of the curve:

$$
r(t)=⟨2 t + 2,\,t⟩,\,1\le t\le 2
$$

Note that the domain $1\le t\le 2$ is defined by the $y$-coordinates of the end-points on the path.

Computing ${r}^{′}(t)$ and $‖{r}^{′}(t)‖,$ we get the following: 

$$
\begin{aligned}{r}^{′}(t) & =\frac{\text{d}x}{\text{d}t}\,i+\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}t}\,j \\  & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}(2 t + 2)i+\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}(t)j \\  & =2\,i+j \\ ‖{r}^{′}(t)‖ & =\sqrt{{(\frac{\text{d}x}{\text{d}t})}^{2}+{(\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}t})}^{2}} \\  & =\sqrt{(2)^2+1^2} \\  & =\sqrt{4+1} \\  & =\sqrt{5}\end{aligned}
$$

 

Now, if  $f(x,y)=6 y,$ then we obtain 

$$
\begin{aligned}f(r(t)) & =6 t \\  & =6 t.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we can write the integral as 

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{C}6 y\,\text{d}s & ={\int }_{1}^{2}f(r(t))\,‖{r}^{′}(t)‖\,\text{d}t \\  & ={\int }_{1}^{2}\left(6 t\right)\cdot\left(\sqrt{5}\right)\,\text{d}t \\  & ={\int }_{1}^{2}6 \sqrt{5} t\,\text{d}t.\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we evaluate the integral as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{1}^{2}6 \sqrt{5} t\,\text{d}t & =\left[3 \sqrt{5} t^{2}\right]_{1}^{2} \\  & =6 \sqrt{5}\left(\frac{2^2}{2}-\frac{1^2}{2}\right) \\  & =6 \sqrt{5}\left(2-\frac{1}{2}\right) \\  & =9 \sqrt{5}\end{aligned}
$$" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy :question/answer-fields ["5aabe041-866e-5d3f-b02e-f537a8abdf22"] :db/ensure :question/validate} {:db/id "9aa6f2cf-f8b0-51f7-9093-58c3d7bf3ebb" :answer/id #uuid "9aa6f2cf-f8b0-51f7-9093-58c3d7bf3ebb" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "29 \sqrt{5}" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "39dca523-9171-5e40-833c-978d9ad71849" :answer/id #uuid "39dca523-9171-5e40-833c-978d9ad71849" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "25 \sqrt{5}" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "473858c3-157d-5055-9739-f0d6b85e7989" :answer/id #uuid "473858c3-157d-5055-9739-f0d6b85e7989" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "78 \sqrt{5}" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "fe15649c-aa4e-5adc-af44-f12a4b3fb802" :answer/id #uuid "fe15649c-aa4e-5adc-af44-f12a4b3fb802" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "21 \sqrt{5}" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "754a7457-a3e8-51f7-b689-9b4291afc217" :answer/id #uuid "754a7457-a3e8-51f7-b689-9b4291afc217" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "21" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "86cb8063-be0e-59e9-b0ab-6ae36122c5ad" :answer-field/id #uuid "86cb8063-be0e-59e9-b0ab-6ae36122c5ad" :answer-field/key "selection" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/radio :answer-field/choices ["9aa6f2cf-f8b0-51f7-9093-58c3d7bf3ebb" "39dca523-9171-5e40-833c-978d9ad71849" "473858c3-157d-5055-9739-f0d6b85e7989" "fe15649c-aa4e-5adc-af44-f12a4b3fb802" "754a7457-a3e8-51f7-b689-9b4291afc217"] :answer-field/correct "fe15649c-aa4e-5adc-af44-f12a4b3fb802" :db/ensure :answer-field/validate} {:db/id "8a06b7a8-a31a-5d91-a4c2-27f8e724e7b7" :question/id #uuid "8a06b7a8-a31a-5d91-a4c2-27f8e724e7b7" :question/problem "Evaluate the line integral

$$

$$
r(t)=⟨t^{2},\,t⟩,\,1\le t\le 2 \sqrt{3}
$$

Note that the domain $1\le t\le 2 \sqrt{3}$ is defined by the $y$-coordinates of the end-points on the path.

Computing ${r}^{′}(t)$ and $‖{r}^{′}(t)‖,$ we get the following: 

$$
\begin{aligned}{r}^{′}(t) & =\frac{\text{d}x}{\text{d}t}\,i+\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}t}\,j \\  & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}(t^{2})i+\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}(t)j \\  & =2 t\,i+j \\ ‖{r}^{′}(t)‖ & =\sqrt{{(\frac{\text{d}x}{\text{d}t})}^{2}+{(\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}t})}^{2}} \\  & =\sqrt{(2 t)^2+1^2} \\  & =\sqrt{4 t^{2}+1} \\  & =\sqrt{4 t^{2} + 1}\end{aligned}
$$

 

Now, if  $f(x,y)=\frac{6 x}{y},$ then we obtain 

$$
\begin{aligned}f(r(t)) & =\frac{6 \left(t^{2}\right)}{t} \\  & =6 t.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we can write the integral as 

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{C}\frac{6 x}{y}\,\text{d}s & ={\int }_{1}^{2 \sqrt{3}}f(r(t))\,‖{r}^{′}(t)‖\,\text{d}t \\  & ={\int }_{1}^{2 \sqrt{3}}\left(6 t\right)\cdot\left(\sqrt{4 t^{2} + 1}\right)\,\text{d}t \\  & ={\int }_{1}^{2 \sqrt{3}}6 t \sqrt{4 t^{2} + 1}\,\text{d}t.\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we solve this using the substitution $u=4 t^{2} + 1,$ $\text{d}u=8 t\,\text{d}t$ as follows:

$$

$$
\begin{aligned}{r}^{′}(t) & =\frac{\text{d}x}{\text{d}t}\,i+\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}t}\,j \\  & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}(\frac{1}{t})i+\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}(t)j \\  & =- \frac{1}{t^{2}}\,i+j \\ ‖{r}^{′}(t)‖ & =\sqrt{{(\frac{\text{d}x}{\text{d}t})}^{2}+{(\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}t})}^{2}} \\  & =\sqrt{(- \frac{1}{t^{2}})^2+1^2} \\  & =\sqrt{\frac{1}{t^{4}}+1} \\  & =\sqrt{1 + \frac{1}{t^{4}}}\end{aligned}

$$

$$

where $C$ is the section of the curve $x=2 \sqrt{y}$ from $(2,1)$ to $(2 \sqrt{5},5),$ as shown above." :question/worked-solution "Notice that the given curve is of the form $x=x(y),$ Therefore, by setting $y=t,$ we have

$$
x=x(t)=2 \sqrt{t}.
$$

This gives the following parametrization of the curve:

$$
r(t)=⟨2 \sqrt{t},\,t⟩,\,1\le t\le 5
$$

Note that the domain $1\le t\le 5$ is defined by the $y$-coordinates of the end-points on the path.

Computing ${r}^{′}(t)$ and $‖{r}^{′}(t)‖,$ we get the following: 

$$
\begin{aligned}{r}^{′}(t) & =\frac{\text{d}x}{\text{d}t}\,i+\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}t}\,j \\  & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}(2 \sqrt{t})i+\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}(t)j \\  & =\frac{1}{\sqrt{t}}\,i+j \\ ‖{r}^{′}(t)‖ & =\sqrt{{(\frac{\text{d}x}{\text{d}t})}^{2}+{(\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}t})}^{2}} \\  & =\sqrt{(\frac{1}{\sqrt{t}})^2+1^2} \\  & =\sqrt{\frac{1}{t}+1} \\  & =\sqrt{1 + \frac{1}{t}}\end{aligned}
$$

 

Now, if  $f(x,y)=8 x y,$ then we obtain 

$$
\begin{aligned}f(r(t)) & =8 \left(2 \sqrt{t}\right) t \\  & =16 t^{\frac{3}{2}}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we can write the integral as 

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{C}8 x y\,\text{d}s & ={\int }_{1}^{5}f(r(t))\,‖{r}^{′}(t)‖\,\text{d}t \\  & ={\int }_{1}^{5}\left(16 t^{\frac{3}{2}}\right)\cdot\left(\sqrt{1 + \frac{1}{t}}\right)\,\text{d}t \\  & ={\int }_{1}^{5}16 t \sqrt{t + 1}\,\text{d}t.\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we solve this using the substitution $u=4 t + 4,$ $\text{d}u=4\,\text{d}t$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{1}^{5}16 t \sqrt{t + 1}\,\text{d}t & =8{\int }_{8}^{24}\frac{u-4}{4}\cdot\sqrt{u}\cdot\frac{1}{4}\,\text{d}u \\  & ={\int }_{8}^{24}\frac{u^{\frac{3}{2}}}{2} - 2 \sqrt{u}\,\text{d}u \\  & =\left[\frac{1}{2}\cdot\left(\frac{2}{5}u^{5/2}-(4)\cdot\frac{2}{3}u^{3/2}\right)\right]_{8}^{24} \\  & =\left[\frac{u^{\frac{5}{2}}}{5} - \frac{4 u^{\frac{3}{2}}}{3}\right]_{8}^{24} \\  & =\left(\left(\frac{\left(24\right)^{\frac{5}{2}}}{5}\right)+\left(- \frac{4 \left(24\right)^{\frac{3}{2}}}{3}\right)\right)-\left(\left(\frac{\left(8\right)^{\frac{5}{2}}}{5}\right)+\left(- \frac{4 \left(8\right)^{\frac{3}{2}}}{3}\right)\right) \\  & =\left(\left(\frac{1152 \sqrt{6}}{5}\right)+\left(- 64 \sqrt{6}\right)\right)-\left(\left(\frac{128 \sqrt{2}}{5}\right)+\left(- \frac{64 \sqrt{2}}{3}\right)\right) \\  & =- \frac{64 \sqrt{2}}{15} + \frac{832 \sqrt{6}}{5}\end{aligned}
$$" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/hard :question/answer-fields ["e1f6ae96-8b2e-581c-93a9-a1569f0c7cc9"] :db/ensure :question/validate} {:db/id "generator" :question-generator/id #uuid "1b5b1178-324b-5bad-aa78-0b6a6b3ba485" :question-generator/script "generate/scratch/17592186179718.py"} [:db/add 17592186179718 :knowledge-point/question-generator "generator"] {:db/id 17592186179718 :knowledge-point/questions ["d33ab010-ae47-54a5-a66e-bc5313115fb2" "8a06b7a8-a31a-5d91-a4c2-27f8e724e7b7" "8c77817c-c092-573a-a129-dda1b7dbaf00" "edc5b731-7331-5410-b96a-68df46082b51" "757a5531-af3b-53d8-af0b-e619bd9a8745" "a1335390-7338-553c-9752-14a0d9faa957" "316743f9-ae6e-5a5c-90d0-c46ad39f440f" "5b75b6c1-d336-52ca-ae2f-f314c60fb3a9" "5487c7b6-44fe-5e39-9226-bf0a43081f99" "f20094c6-0c28-54cf-af5d-3c0a666f7927"]} [:db/ensure 17592186179718 :knowledge-point/validate]]
